description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing equity profile data from the TMX (Toronto Stock Exchange) API, including query parameter classes, data models with field mappings, and asynchronous data fetching and transformation methods.

classes.name: TmxEquityQuoteQueryParams
classes.description: Class for TMX equity profile query parameters, extending standard equity quote query parameters with support for multiple symbols.

classes.name: TmxEquityQuoteData
classes.description: Data model for TMX equity profile data, including field aliases and validation methods for dates and percentages.

classes.name: TmxEquityQuoteFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving TMX equity data asynchronously, transforming query parameters, fetching data via GraphQL, and processing the results into data models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms a dictionary of parameters into a TmxEquityQuoteQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches equity data for given symbols from TMX GraphQL endpoint, returning a list of raw data dictionaries.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw fetched data into structured TmxEquityQuoteData instances, cleaning and sorting the data.
